title: Gary Webb and CIA cocaine in the inner city

tellings.quote:
Gary Webb, the guy that knew the CIA
brought Coke into the hood.

plain: A man named Gary Webb knew that the CIA, the US spy agency, brought cocaine into poor Black neighbourhoods of American cities, in a story that runs from about 1980 to 2004. A guest named Kurt Metzger says this in passing while talking with the host, and he gives no more than that one line. He offers it as an example of a man who knew what the agency was doing.
